status.nb: 86 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 32 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: Pakistani security forces returned fire on Afghan Taliban posts in South Waziristan after the Taliban opened fire on border posts. In Karachi a PIA engineer was gunned down in a suspected targeted attack. Multiple attacks hit Pakistani forces in Balochistan. A Learjet crashed in Florida, unrelated to the regional conflict. The conflict caused 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker svarte med skudd på afghanske Talibanposter i Sør Waziristan etter at Taliban åpnet ild mot grenseposter. I Karachi ble en PIA-ingeniør skutt ned i et antatt målrettet angrep. Flere angrep rammet pakistanske styrker i Balochistan. Et Learjet styrtet i Florida, uten tilknytning til den regionale konflikten. Konflikten forårsaket 1,794 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
